newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nissho Iwai picks Nomura for Asian note.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai picks Nomura for Asian note.

text.p: Nissho Iwai International Singapore Ltd said on Tuesday it has mandated Nomura Singapore to lead manage its US$500 million Asian medium term note programme.

In a statement issued by Nissho Iwai Singapore, a wholly owned subsidiary of Japan's Nissho Iwai Corp, the company said the note programme had been rated "A" by Nippon Investors Services, Inc and "A" by the Japan Bond Research Institute.
A Nomura official said the notes were not guaranteed but they were backed by a "Keep Well Agreement" given by the parent Nissho Iwai Corp.
Nissho Iwai Singapore has recieved approval from the Stock Exchange of Singapore to list the notes, which may be issued under the programme.
The company is a general trading company engaged in domestic and offshore trading.
The statement said the funds raised under the programme would be used by Nissho Iwai Singapore for the general financing of its non-Singapore dollar denominated activities.
